events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Coos Jct
events.description: 2 deaths. Coos County. Gusty winds from a severe thunderstorm toppled and snapped trees along the Connecticut River and caused a circus tent to collapse at the Lancaster Fairgrounds. About 100 people were under the tent at the time it collapsed. A 41-year-old man and his 6-year-old daughter were killed in the incident. Another 32 people were reported to have been treated at nearby hospitals. Winds were estimated to have gusted up to 75 mph in the hardest hit area along the Connecticut River where most of the tree damage occurred. No structural damage occurred to any of the permanent buildings at the fairgrounds.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Puckershire
events.description: 1 death. Sullivan County. A severe thunderstorm downed trees on Sugar River Drive and Chestnut Street in Claremont. a 24-year-old man was killed when a tree uprooted and fell on the car he was driving.
